title: Siman 346
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: הוּא לְהֶפֶךְ שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק אֲמִתִּי, אֲזַי הוּא חִדּוּשׁ נִפְלָא וְנוֹרָא וְנִשְׂגָּב שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְשַׁעֵר בְּמחַ אֱנוֹשִׁי כְּלָל. כִּי כָּךְ הָיוּ רְגִילִים רב הָעוֹלָם לוֹמַר עָלָיו זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְהוּא זִכְרוֹנוֹ
segments.en:
(7.) It was heard from his holy mouth that he said: "His holy book Likutay Moharan that came out into the world is the beginning of the Redemption." And he said: "Since it has come out into the world I very much desire that they study it — for one must study it much until it is fluent by heart. For it is full of moral instruction and very great awakening toward Hashem Yisburach And he said that...

[I heard from the mouth of our holy Rabbainu who said and praised himself a little: "If I were to begin to speak wisdoms — all the listeners would depart from their souls from the hearing. But because of this I am unable — for when I begin to speak, I would be nullified, because I want someone else to speak. Even though he does not know what he is speaking — even so, I am able to extract from his words great wisdoms. Therefore I am unable to speak."]
